title: SAVA Gelaro S4 GRX400 carbon gravel bike
notes: Current exact R21-GRX400-20S manufacturer page identifies a T800 carbon frame and fork, internal routing, BBT47, Shimano GRX400 2x10, approximately 10.2 kg complete weight, 700x40C fitted tires and 45C maximum compatibility. The manufacturer describes optimized lay-up and lateral stiffness around the rear-stay/seat-tube junction but publishes neither a lay-up schedule nor an independent stiffness protocol. The US$1,799 direct price is not a mainland CNY checkout observation.
